hooks.command: file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file_path" in *src/main/kotlin/*.kt) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"; if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src/test/resources/features 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Blocked: about to modify production code ($file_path) with no .feature file changes in this changeset yet. Write or update the Gherkin scenario first, run Cucumber to confirm it fails, then implement." 1>&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; exit 0

file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file_path" in *.kt|*.kts) out=$("${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/gradlew" -p "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" detekt --console=plain 2>&1); ec=$?; if [ $ec -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" | grep -v WARNING 1>&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; exit 0

file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); case "$file_path" in *src/main/kotlin/*.kt) echo "$ts MAIN_WRITE ${file_path#${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/}" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/tdd-events.log" ;; *src/test/resources/features/*.feature) echo "$ts FEATURE_WRITE ${file_path#${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/}" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/tdd-events.log" ;; esac; exit 0
out=$("${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/gradlew" -p "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" check --console=plain 2>&1); ec=$?; if [ $ec -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" | grep -v WARNING | tail -80 1>&2; exit 2; fi
